svg.title: How Blindfill and Confidential Trenches fit together
svg.desc: Apps call the kit's one public entry. Your device holds the 12 words and wallet keys, keeps private notes, makes proofs ahead of time, checks every quote and signs orders in advance. Helpers carry messages and hold no money keys. The vault on NEAR has no key and pays only the accounts a proof names. NEAR Intents moves money between the vault, any wallet, any address and fresh wallets on any chain it reaches. The exit tool brings money home with only the 12 words and public NEAR RPCs.
svg.text: The signing page, on its own address
Keys are made here and never leave
No key, no owner, no upgrade, no pause
Holds everyone's USDC in one pool
Pays only the accounts a proof names
Keeps its money outside NEAR Intents
Signed on your device, filled on the chain's own pools
Your 12 words and public NEAR RPCs, no server of ours
